svg.title: Containers and data flow
svg.desc: Input: selected laboratory data; pipeline.toml + catalog.csv + separate secrets; Python runner: one-shot container or uv command; Terminology evidence; Optional Ollama service; Optional local validation services; Output and clinical review

g.text: Input: selected laboratory data
CSV columns or read-only SQLite / PostgreSQL view
FHIR JSON / Bundle / NDJSON / DB resource column
TORCH / CQL creates the selected FHIR export
pipeline.toml + catalog.csv + separate secrets
Input/columns, item / distinct output
profile-init downloads pinned profile / bindings to local/
Terminology endpoints/files; local model + research
Python runner: one-shot container or uv command
Read and check input contract; optional full FHIR validation
Preserve code + name + value + unit + reference context
Aggregate complete sets and statistics with embedded DuckDB
A1 checks; separate A2 / A3 research from audited A1 output
CSV + HTML + evidence + hash-chained audit
Terminology evidence
Direct local files OR API
Optional Blaze: explicit imports
UCUM: NLM API OR local service
Sources / editions / hashes
Optional Ollama service
Local inference; shared weights
A2: real lookup candidates
A3: Europe PMC / PubMed
Quotes + numbers + unit guards
Optional local validation services
Matchbox: HL7 validator + acquired FHIR / MII packages
Blaze: terminology, persistent database, internal network
Complete documents checked before semantic grouping
Output and clinical review
One item/group per CSV row; one value per cell; numbered columns for repeated elements
HTML: source value → method/finding → proposal → source/proposal status and citations
Original structures in evidence JSONL; clinician decisions in a versioned local registry

svg.text: Read-only inputs/configuration · writable output · retained model and terminology volumes
